name: Triangle Terror Con
blurb: A locally owned, family-run horror and pop-culture convention at the Millennium Hotel in Durham, North Carolina.
notes: Both the homepage and About Us page confirm a single-day event on September 26, 2026 at the Millennium Hotel, Durham, NC ('Join us at the Millennium Hotel Durham on September 26th, 2026...'); a web search corroborates the venue address (2800 Campus Walk Ave, Durham). That date is before the 2026-10-05 research window, and the site is now in post-event mode ('DID YOU ATTEND THIS YEAR'S EVENT? WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU'), so it is recorded as 'last' with no 2027 edition announced yet. No organizer/company name is given anywhere on the site beyond 'locally owned and family-operated', so organizer is left blank. Guests were not researched since there is no upcoming edition; the site's nav has no dedicated guests page (only Cosplay, About Us, Sponsorship, Previous Events).
